meta.description: Access points within 800m catchment of each corridor station. Used for routing origin/destination matching.
meta.provenance_note: The ap_* coordinates here are planning approximations, superseded as evidence by the 50 official LandsD iGeoCom MTA access records in data/access/station_entrances.json (PROVENANCE S23/S30). Station-level step-free access is verified against the MTR barrier-free CSV (2026-09-25), but individual approximated entrances are NOT mapped to specific exits, so mtr_entrance accessible is null rather than an unsupported true. Coordinates never imply walk connectivity; bus_stop accessible=true means a ground-level kerb stop, not a surveyed wheelchair assessment - line-level bus wheelchair suitability remains unverified.
